params.name: workRequestId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the asynchronous work request.

params.name: status
params.description: A filter to return only the resources that match the given lifecycle state.

params.name: resourceId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the resource affected by the work request.

params.name: page
params.description:
For list pagination. The value of the opc-next-page response header from the previous
"List" call. For important details about how pagination works, see
[List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

params.name: limit
params.description:
For list pagination. The maximum number of results per page, or items to return in a
paginated "List" call. For important details about how pagination works, see
[List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either ascending (`ASC`) or descending (`DESC`).

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort by. Only one sort order may be provided. Default order for `timeAccepted` is descending.
